3950.title: Composer sizing and iOS verification limits
3950.rootCauseOneLine: The editor cap uses dvh while the shell uses visualViewport.height; an isolated component probe exceeds a synthetic visible-area budget. Full iOS behavior is unverified.
3950.proposedFix: Measure actual shell, editor and toolbar bounds with the iOS keyboard open; evaluate reusing the existing shell-height signal if the mismatch is confirmed.
3950.caveats: Component-level reproduction only; no native keyboard, full app layout, touch-caret or dictation verification. No safe automatic fix PR.
